The '''33rd Producers Guild of America Awards''' (also known as '''2022 Producers Guild Awards''' or '''2022 PGA Awards'''), honoring the best [[Film producer|film]] and [[television producer]]s of 2021, were held at the [[The Century Plaza Hotel|Fairmont Century Plaza]] in [[Los Angeles]], [[California]] on March 19, 2022.<ref>{{cite news |last1=Donnelly |first1=Matt |title='CODA,' 'Succession' Take Top Prizes at Producers Guild Awards |url=https://variety.com/2022/film/news/producers-guild-awards-2022-winners-llist-1235209868/ |access-date=March 20, 2022 |work=Variety |date=March 19, 2022}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |last1=Tapp |first1=Tom |title=Producers Guild Awards Winners In Sports, Children's, Short Form & Innovation Categories Announced |url=https://deadline.com/2022/03/producers-guild-awards-winners-announced-1234978687/ |website=Deadline |access-date=March 20, 2022 |date=March 14, 2022}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Producers Guild of America Awards Celebrates ''CODA'', ''Succession'', ''Encanto'', ''Summer of Soul'', ''Ted Lasso'', & More with Top Honors |url=https://producersguild.org/2022-pgaaward-winners/ |publisher=Producers Guild of America |access-date=March 22, 2022 |date=March 19, 2022}}</ref> Originally scheduled to take place on February 26, 2022, the ceremony was postponed amid a surge in [[COVID-19]] infections due to the [[SARS-CoV-2 Omicron variant|Omicron variant]].<ref name="PostponementTHR">{{cite news |last1=Verhoeven |first1=Beatrice |title=Producers Guild Postpones 2022 Awards Ceremony Amid COVID-19 Surge |url=https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/movies/movie-news/producers-guild-postpones-2022-awards-1235074315/ |access-date=January 13, 2022 |work=The Hollywood Reporter |date=January 13, 2022}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |last1=Haring |first1=Bruce |title=Producers Guild Awards Postponed Until Mid-March Amid Omicron Surge |url=https://deadline.com/2022/01/producers-guild-awards-postponed-covid-2022-1234909742/ |website=Deadline |access-date=January 13, 2022 |date=January 13, 2022}}</ref><ref>{{cite news category were announced on December 10, 2021,<ref>{{cite web |last1=Pond |first1=Steve |title='Ascension,' 'Flee' and 'Summer of Soul' Land Producers Guild Documentary Nominations
